title: lichen-schc link_layer_integration test target does not compile: sb0b-family APIs missing
description: Pre-existing on beads-worker-7 (verified with the delta stashed): cargo test -p lichen-schc --test link_layer_integration fails with 12 errors - unresolved imports lichen_link::identity / lichen_link::link_layer / lichen_link::Seed / lichen_schc::link, no AuthenticatedPeerSchcContext::from_authenticated_dio_frame, no FragmentationPolicy::accept_peer, no AuthenticatedFragmentReceiver::new. The test file (merged in 660b9bf3bf) depends on sb0b-family lib APIs that live on unmerged worker branches. Blocks cargo test -p lichen-schc from running that target; every other lichen-schc target passes. Fix: land the sb0b API surface (owner Mark Atwood per sb0b) or gate the test target until the APIs exist.
